title: Homological kernel and detection of its cone class
statement: Let $\mathcal T$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category], let $\mathcal B$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and let $H:\mathcal T\to\mathcal B$ be an additive homological functor [def-sp-homological-functor]. Put $\mathcal S=\{X\mid H(X[n])=0\text{ for every }n\in\mathbf Z\}$, the full subcategory on these objects. Then $\mathcal S$ is replete and triangulated (contains zero, is closed under shifts, and if the outer objects of a distinguished triangle lie in $\mathcal S$, so does its middle object). For a morphism $f:X\to Y$, there exists a distinguished triangle $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\to Z\to X[1]$ with $Z\in\mathcal S$ if and only if $H(f[n])$ is an isomorphism for every $n\in\mathbf Z$.
